sources.excerpt:
Williams Supa Fuzz Home Fuzz Pedals MK11 OC81D MK11 Classic MK1 Classic MK1.5 Fuzz MK111 Fuzz Supa Fuzz BuZZaFuZZ Boost Pedals The Ranger Ranger Gold PowerDriver Pedal Mods & Repairs Pedal Repairs Pedal Mods Feedback About Contact --> Williams SUPA FUZZ - The Williams Supa Fuzz is a very faithful recreation of the legendary Marshall Supa Fuzz pedal. Built by Sola Sound in the 1960's for Marshall Amplification, the Supa Fuzz was one of the most popular incarnations of the Tonebender and famously used by Pete Townshend amongst many others including Jeff Beck. The Supa Fuzz circuit is very similar to the MK11 circuit, the main variations being found in capacitor values and the use of OC75 transistors. These subtle changes in the circuit produce the 'ballsiest' of the Tonebender family, the fuzz feels thicker with a touch more lower end. Like the MK11, when the fuzz is fully dialed-in, the tone is saturated with masses of sustain, yet amazingly responsive to the dynamics, chords are big and rich yet still articulate and warm. Single notes sustain until eventually ringing out into dying upper harmonics. Again, like the standard MK11, bring back the volume on the guitar and the Supa Fuzz takes on a different feel, things start to clean-up, starting from a dynamic crunch superb for rhythm work, through to almost clean with a slight crunch and finally to a shimmering clean sound. All the time, retaining the individual feel of the Supa Fuzz. The Williams Supa Fuzz is built as close to an original 1960's model as possible. Using my own original as a reference model, parts have been carefully selected to achieve the exact tones of the Supa Fuzz whilst also providing stability and low background noise. In the Supa Fuzz I use a trio of Vintage Germanium Transistors, usually Mullard or NKT. These Transistors are specially selected for gain, low leakage and low noise. These are then combined with the very best selection of nos (new old stock) capacitors from manufacturers such as Mullard, Hunts and Erie. All resistors are either original 1960's or the very best modern Carbon Composition. Features : A trio of vintage Germanium transistors, often Mullard, selected especially for low leakage and low noise. A selection of the finest vintage capacitors from manufactures such as Erie and Mullard. Highest quality electrolytic capacitors. Carbon Comp resistors throughout. Grey Hammerite painted Eddystone / Hammond box Bulgin style chicken head knobs. Free Optional LED Indicator Hand-Labeled Design Neutrik Sockets, Alpha pots, high quality Stomp Switch True-bypass Life-time warranty on all Williams Audio parts and work Each pedal is individually signed and numbered   Price: £159 Worldwide Shipping £10.  Please Allow Up to 12 Weeks On this pedal I am currently updating the website so please Contact Me for more Info or to order.     * Prices and estimated times updated April 2026   Copyright © 2010 Williams Audio UK |

Williams Audio Supa Fuzz - Fuzz Pedal | PedalFinder Guitar Pedal Finder Explore Brands Guides Pedalboards FAQ Home / Williams Audio / Supa Fuzz Williams Audio Supa Fuzz Prepare to be enveloped in a thick, gritty fuzz that oozes pure rock 'n' roll attitude. The Williams Audio Supa Fuzz is a faithful recreation of the legendary Marshall Supa Fuzz, a pedal that defined the sound of 60s British rock. Designed by the renowned Sola Sound for Marshall Amplification, this pedal was a favorite of iconic guitarists like Pete Townshend and Jeff Beck, who used it to sculpt their signature tones. At the heart of the Supa Fuzz lies a Tone Bender-inspired circuit, but with a few key tweaks that give it a uniquely bold and ballsy character. The use of OC75 germanium transistors, carefully selected for low noise and high gain, produces a fuzz that is both thick and responsive. Crank the knobs and you'll be rewarded with masses of sustain, yet the pedal remains remarkably dynamic, articulating each chord and note with clarity and warmth. But the Supa Fuzz is more than just a one-trick pony. Roll back your guitar's volume and you'll discover a wide range of tones, from a dynamic crunch perfect for rhythm work, to a shimmering clean with just a hint of grit. It's a pedal that rewards experimentation and allows you to unlock a multitude of classic rock textures. Meticulously handcrafted in the UK using premium components, the Williams Audio Supa Fuzz is a faithful recreation of a true tone icon. If you're seeking the ballsy, harmonically rich fuzz that defined an era, this pedal is your gateway to the sound of 60s British rock royalty.
